label: ren run
args: if command -v ren >/dev/null 2>&1; then ren run "$ZED_FILE"; else dune exec --no-print-directory ren -- run "$ZED_FILE"; fi

label: ren test: $ZED_CUSTOM_name
args: name=$(printf '%s' "$ZED_CUSTOM_name" | sed -e 's/^"//' -e 's/"$//' -e 's/\\\(.\)/\1/g'); if command -v ren >/dev/null 2>&1; then ren test "$ZED_FILE" --only "$name" --exact; else dune exec --no-print-directory ren -- test "$ZED_FILE" --only "$name" --exact; fi

label: ren test
args: if command -v ren >/dev/null 2>&1; then ren test "$ZED_DIRNAME"; else dune exec --no-print-directory ren -- test "$ZED_DIRNAME"; fi

label: ren check
args: if command -v ren >/dev/null 2>&1; then ren check "$ZED_FILE"; else dune exec --no-print-directory ren -- check "$ZED_FILE"; fi

label: ren types
args: if command -v ren >/dev/null 2>&1; then ren types "$ZED_FILE"; else dune exec --no-print-directory ren -- types "$ZED_FILE"; fi
